context_notes:
Phase 1 is COMPLETE: verification `passed` at 22/22, all three UAT items closed against real hardware, CI green on Node 22 and 24. Working tree clean, both branches pushed, main untouched at 95f999b.

The theme of this session was that green gates were checking the wrong things, four separate times.

1. The shipped REST client could not talk to the vendor AT ALL. GET /devices returns { devices: [...] } not a bare array, GET /devices/{id} wraps under the singular key `device`, and serialNumber lives at attributes.serialNumber. 464 unit tests and 35 scenarios passed against it, through code review, verification, Nyquist validation and a security audit reaching threats_open 0 — because the fixtures AND the Cucumber fake encoded the same wrong assumption as the production code. Found by pointing it at the real API. Fixed in 260829-gx6, verified 10/10.

2. A plan's failing-scenario grep was derived by reading the Cucumber formatter source and independently 'confirmed' by a reviewer reading the same source. Both wrong: it matched 0 of 16 real failures and would have reported a red gate as green. The executor caught it by running Cucumber.

3. The suite could not pass a CI runner, undetected across 174 commits because the branches were never pushed. Three timing guesses standing in for synchronization: a case waiting on a real AbortSignal.timeout, which Node makes UNREF'D so it loses to an empty event loop; and two cases draining a fixed 8 event-loop turns before asserting async work had finished. Recorded as W12 — on Node 22 the cancellation cascade removed the evidence for truth 17, which three consecutive reports had asserted.

4. My own UAT 2 claim was wrong. I reported the heartbeat proving SC-3a because shadowVersion advanced and the key count held. It does not: once a watermark exists nextShadowVersion returns patch.version ?? previous without consulting `observed`, so a silently dropped patch produces identical output. The decisive evidence was get/accepted, where the watermark went from undefined to defined — establishing one requires an observation, and the poll path can only preserve. Partial merge is now deductive, tracked as W10-R, closed by printing receivedAt.

Live API probes are preserved at ~/bg-uat-probes/ with a README; credentials at ~/.gs-uat.env (gs, not bg). Use w10-probe.mjs rather than uat-probe.mjs: tapping the transport proves a message arrived, not that the plugin used it.

Process notes: an isolated executor cannot see untracked files from the shared checkout, so commit the PLAN before dispatching (skipping worktree-pre-dispatch-commit cost one halted dispatch). Docker test runs as root leave dist-test root-owned and the next local run fails EACCES — chown it back. Local Node is 26 while CI is 22/24, so verify on a supported runtime before calling a gate green.
